definitions.known: measured + published_fit + derived + inferred (published_fit: a value another project fitted or chose and published, e.g. BAAIWorm's densities; inferred: inferred by this project)
definitions.placeholder: guessed: a number the model runs on, inside a stated range, not from data
definitions.gap: absent: a number the real worm has that the model does not use yet
definitions.precision_needed: 'not yet estimated' everywhere until a sensitivity run gives a value with its method

totals_physiology.note: excluding structure rows (morphology points, connectome counts and pair lists)

open_questions.question: Why does the neural-only network settle into a fixed depolarised state? At the ledger defaults (wiring=cook, strengths at the range log-midpoint) 206 of 302 neurons sit above -20 mV at 6 s with transmitter signs (D7) and 100 with receptor_sign on (D8, Fenyves first). Localised to recurrent chemical excitation (isolated cells rest at -53 to -56 mV); receptor-level inhibition halves it but does not remove it.
open_questions.candidates: per-EM synapse strength (range B4 is inferred from circuit models, not measured); the graded release curve (Vth -20 mV, delta 5 mV, BAAIWorm's fit); per-EM gap strength (range C4 guessed); missing extrasynaptic and neuromodulatory inhibition (layers off in these runs)
open_questions.status: open; nothing tuned. The closed loop runs on D8's configuration, labelled. Section 5: four single range ends each bring it under 30 (chemical strength 0.1 nS, excitatory reversal -10 mV, excitatory release slope 2 mV, inhibitory release threshold -45 mV); none has a measured value for or against it (RANGE_ENDS_LIT.md, section 6a). With the excitatory reversal range widened to +11 mV (measured) the template is +0.5 mV and the count is 105 (D8b)

mechanisms.name: Literature wins: ported values outside a literature range are clipped to it
mechanisms.notes: clips neuron cm (A1), leak reversal (A5), Ra (A6), muscle leak reversal (F1), excitatory synapse reversal (B5), synaptic decay (B3), conductance per EM synapse (B4) and per EM gap junction (C4; C4 itself is guessed, checked against the measured pair coupling C2); clipped elements are labelled guessed. Also fixes the Ca units bug (ca_pool notes) and sets celsius 20

mechanisms.source: BAAIWorm b99ca5a (Zhao et al. 2024 Nat Comput Sci)
mechanisms.notes: units bug as published: cai is in uM in the mod but NEURON's Nernst reads it as mM against cao 2 mM, so eca sits near +41 mV at rest instead of about +130 mV (measured on backhouse: eca 41.2 mV at cai 0.065). Fixed under literature_overrides (known value, literature wins): the outside Ca is entered as 2000 (uM, the same units as cai), cai starts at caeq 0.05 uM, celsius 20; eca then follows Nernst at about +130 mV at rest (derived). literature_overrides off = as published

mechanisms.name: Connectome: Cook et al. 2019, every pair (wiring=cook), or BAAIWorm's construction as published (wiring=baaiworm: tanh-compressed counts placed on segments in contact)
mechanisms.source: Cook et al. 2019 SI 5 (data/worm/structure); BAAIWorm b99ca5a (Zhao et al. 2024 Nat Comput Sci) config2detailed
mechanisms.notes: Default cook since 5 Nov (port302c passed G1-G3 as pre-registered, docs/worm/BRAIN_PORT.md section 3; it saturated more than baaiworm on the old templates: 188 vs 141 neurons above -20 mV at 6 s; see open_questions: saturation). BAAIWorm's neuron-neuron counts (SI5-302.xlsx) equal Cook 2019 exactly (3709 chemical pairs, 20965 synapses; 1091 gap pairs; checked 5 Nov), but its construction places a site on only 2306 chemical and 599 gap pairs (single-synapse pairs round to 0 sites; other pairs have no neurite contact within 1 um). Its neuron-muscle table is its own (552 binary pairs, 76 motor neurons; 337 are Cook edges, Cook has 956 pairs from 162 neurons) and it adds 175 muscle-to-neuron feedback synapses that are not anatomical (Cook has none; the sens_proprio layer covers proprioception). wiring=cook uses Cook for all of it: BAAIWorm's sites where it placed any, else one site on the nearest segment pair

mechanisms.name: Synapse sign by presynaptic transmitter (GABA-only presynaptic neuron -> inhibitory)
mechanisms.neutral: allexc = BAAIWorm as published (every synapse excitatory)
mechanisms.source: Wang et al. 2024 transmitter atlas, CeNGEN markers as fallback

mechanisms.name: Synapse sign by postsynaptic receptor: Fenyves et al. 2020's published prediction (NT+R) where it is + or -; else inhibitory where the postsynaptic class expresses more chloride-channel receptors (GluCl, ACC, UNC-49) for the presynaptic transmitter than cation-channel ones, in summed CeNGEN TPM (our guessed rule); the transmitter rule where it expresses neither
mechanisms.source: Fenyves et al. 2020 PLoS Comput Biol 16:e1007974 S1 Data (CC BY); CeNGEN threshold 2 (Taylor et al. 2021), receptor families from WormBase
mechanisms.notes: 9 of 3709 pairs carry a measured sign (Roberts et al. 2016: AVA<->AVB and ASH->AVB inhibitory; BRAIN_PORT 9), 1703 from Fenyves (+ or -), 1577 from our CeNGEN rule, 420 from the transmitter rule; Fenyves and our rule disagree on 182 of the 1703 (Fenyves used); 1048 pairs differ from the transmitter rule. Fenyves calls 436 pairs complex (both signs; our rule used)

mechanisms.name: Gap junctions as innexin channels: conductance per EM contact = open channels x innexin unitary conductance (one shared value; no per-innexin measurement found); no junction where a partner expresses no innexin in CeNGEN. wiring=cook neuron-neuron gaps only. Rectification by innexin pair is not modelled: 923 of 1091 pairs could pair UNC-7 with UNC-9 by expression, so expression does not pick out the rectifying ones
mechanisms.source: CeNGEN threshold 2 (Taylor et al. 2021), 17 innexin genes; Bhattacharya et al. 2019 innexin atlas not yet used

mechanisms.name: Cell morphologies (NEURON hoc, 3D points with diameters)
mechanisms.source: BAAIWorm b99ca5a (Zhao et al. 2024 Nat Comput Sci) model/*.hoc (from the OpenWorm / Virtual Worm NeuroML cells)

mechanisms.name: Body-wall muscle K and Ca channels (c302 C2, Boyle and Cohen 2008 style)
mechanisms.notes: on: c302's generated NEURON mods (gate ODEs in exact form for the 0.5 ms step, BRAIN_PORT section 6 M2) replace BAAIWorm's passive muscle membrane, values from these rows; reversals are fixed in the mods. As published the muscle is graded (rests at -28.6 mV, plateaus under current, no repetitive spikes), unlike real body-wall muscle's Ca action potentials (Gao and Zhen 2011)

mechanisms.name: Repellents and nociception (ASH, ADL, AWB, PHA/PHB)
Light (LITE-1 in ASJ, ASK, ASH, AWB, ASI)
Food cue at the mouth (ADF, ASI, ASJ, NSM)
Gentle touch (MEC-4 in ALM, AVM, PLM, PVM)
Harsh and nose touch (PVD, FLP, ASH, OLQ, IL1)
BWM membrane V -> Ca (lumped, passive muscles)
Amphid sheath glia, lumped as a sensory gain
Homeostatic self-tuning: a slow bias current pulls each neuron's V toward a target
Hours-scale sensory adaptation (EGL-4, CMK-1), lumped as a slow gain drift
Rectifying gap junctions (AVA-A class UNC-7/UNC-9)
mechanisms.source: src/wormemu/nmodl/rectgap.mod (ours; BAAIWorm's junction with a direction)
mechanisms.notes: on: the 86 Cook pairs between AVA, AVB, AVD, AVE, PVC and DA, VA, DB, VB pass current from the motor neuron into the interneuron at the template conductance and the other way at template / gap_rect_ratio. Direction measured for AVA-VA5 (Liu et al. 2017 Nat Commun 8:14818, paired recording); the other classes by the class rule, inferred. Checks: BRAIN_PORT section 7
